verdict.rationale: Apify documents its own monitoring capability for checking Actor performance and receiving alerts, which touches the metrics-monitoring core of this story. Nothing in the evidence shows a real-time dashboard, live system metrics, or worker/browser pool status views. Log streaming via the client is a separate, adjacent feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of a real-time dashboard, live system-level metrics, worker/browser pool status visibility, detailed monitoring docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monitor live system metrics and worker/browser pool status through a real-time dashboard

citations.quote: Check the performance of your Actors, validate data quality, and receive alerts.
